en: A black‑and‑white landscape view showing a solitary half‑timbered house or inn in front of a forested hillside. The building has a characteristic timber-frame façade with light infill panels, a steep roof and several small windows. It stands in an open grassy field bordered by trees, with large coniferous trees on the left and right and low hills covered with forest in the background. The image has a white strip or damage along the bottom edge, suggesting it is a scan of an old postcard or photograph. No clear printed caption is visible on the front.
